about: THE SPEED LOCK, this office's own pins (the owner 2026-10-27: "ths speed lock is very important"; "nothing can depend on the orginal"): each speed check file, its path and the sha256 the owner pinned; copied once 2026-10-27 from the original's settings.json speed_locked.
